name: 갈릭치킨볶음밥

steps.text_en: 2 tbsp oil, fry garlic on low heat

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Garlic edges turn pale gold
sous_chef.say: 마늘이 연한 금색이에요. 이제 양파 넣어요.
sous_chef.say_en: Garlic's pale gold. Add the onion now.

steps.text_en: Add onion, cook until translucent
Add chicken, sear the outside

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue_en: Underside of the chicken coating darkens
sous_chef.say: 아래가 다시 바삭해졌어요. 한 번 뒤집어요.
sous_chef.say_en: The bottom's crisp again. Flip it once.

steps.text_en: Add rice, press flat and fry

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue: 팬 바닥에서 타닥 소리가 커짐, 밥알 가장자리 갈색
sous_chef.cue_en: Crackling gets louder, rice edges brown
sous_chef.say: 바닥이 눌기 직전이에요. 한 번 뒤섞어요.
sous_chef.say_en: It's about to stick. Toss it once.

steps.text_en: Season with ⅓ tbsp salt

learn_points: 마늘은 연한 금색이 되면 불을 줄인다
치킨은 겉이 노릇해지면 뒤집는다
밥은 팬에 눌러 펴서 볶아야 고슬고슬하다
learn_points_en: Turn down the heat when garlic turns pale gold
Flip the chicken once the outside is golden
Press the rice flat in the pan so it fries, not steams

name: 마늘볶음밥

steps.text: 찬 팬에 기름과 마늘 넣고 약불로 켜기
steps.text_en: Put oil and garlic in a cold pan, then turn on low heat
Fry until the garlic turns golden

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Garlic is golden and the bubbling slows
sous_chef.say_en: It's golden now. Any longer and it turns bitter.

steps.text_en: Add rice, press flat and fry

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue_en: Crackling gets louder
sous_chef.say_en: Toss it before it sticks.

steps.text: 팬 가장자리에 간장 ½숟가락 둘러 눌리기
steps.text_en: Drizzle ½ tbsp soy sauce around the edge of the pan
Top with a fried egg (optional)

learn_points: 마늘은 찬 기름부터 약불로 올려야 안 탄다
간장은 팬 가장자리에 둘러야 불향이 난다
learn_points_en: Start garlic in cold oil on low heat so it doesn't burn
Pour soy sauce around the pan's edge for a smoky flavor

name: 치킨 양파볶음
prep: 치킨 뼈 발라 한입 크기로 자르기
prep_en: Cut ½ onion into thick strips
Take the chicken off the bone, cut into bite-size pieces
Mix 1 tbsp soy sauce + ½ tbsp sugar + 2 tbsp water

steps.text_en: Oil the pan, stir-fry the onion on medium heat
Add chicken, warm one side

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue: 아랫면 튀김옷이 다시 바삭, 색이 진해짐
sous_chef.cue_en: Coating on the underside crisps up and darkens
sous_chef.say_en: Flip it now. Just once.

steps.text_en: Pour in the sauce and toss quickly

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 불 줄일 때를 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to turn down the heat
sous_chef.cue_en: Sauce starts bubbling
sous_chef.say_en: The sauce is boiling. Turn it down and toss.

steps.text_en: Turn off the heat when the sauce is almost gone

learn_points: 남은 치킨은 뒤집기 한 번만 해야 튀김옷이 안 벗겨진다
learn_points_en: Flip leftover chicken only once so the coating stays on

name: 양파 수프

steps.text_en: Melt butter, cook the onion on medium-low heat

steps.text: 양파가 갈색이 될 때까지 계속 볶기
steps.text_en: Keep cooking until the onion turns brown

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue: 양파가 진한 갈색, 바닥에 갈색 막
sous_chef.cue_en: Onion is deep brown, brown film on the pot
sous_chef.say: 이 갈색이 맛이에요. 바닥에 물 조금 부어 긁어요.
sous_chef.say_en: That brown is the flavor. Add a splash of water and scrape the bottom.

steps.text_en: Add 300 ml water and soy sauce, bring to a boil

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 끓어 넘치기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it boils over
sous_chef.cue_en: Foam rises at the edge of the pot
sous_chef.say_en: It's boiling. Turn it down to low.

steps.text_en: Simmer 10 min on low, season with salt and pepper
Top with bread and cheese (optional)

learn_points: 양파는 오래 볶아 갈색이 될수록 단맛이 난다
바닥에 눌은 갈색은 물로 긁어 국물에 녹인다
learn_points_en: The longer onions cook and brown, the sweeter they get
Scrape up the brown bits with water and melt them into the soup

name: 계란볶음밥

steps.text: 기름 두르고 약불로 파 볶아 파기름 내기
steps.text_en: Oil the pan, fry green onion on low heat for scallion oil

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Green onion edges just about to brown
sous_chef.say_en: Almost golden. Pour in the egg.

steps.text: 계란 붓고 반쯤 익으면 바로 밥 넣기
steps.text_en: Pour in the egg, add rice as soon as it's half set

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Egg is half set, still wet
sous_chef.say: 반만 익었을 때 밥 넣어요. 지금이에요.
sous_chef.say_en: Add the rice while it's half cooked. Now.

steps.text_en: Press the rice flat and stir-fry

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue_en: Crackling gets louder
sous_chef.say_en: Toss it before it sticks.

steps.text_en: Season with ½ tbsp soy sauce and salt

learn_points: 파기름은 파가 노릇해지기 직전까지
밥은 팬에 눌러 펴서 볶기
계란은 반만 익었을 때 밥을 넣어야 밥알에 코팅된다
learn_points_en: Scallion oil: stop just before the scallions brown
Press the rice flat in the pan to fry
Add rice while the egg is half set so it coats every grain

name: 김치볶음밥

steps.text: 기름 두르고 중불로 김치와 설탕 볶기
steps.text_en: Oil the pan, stir-fry kimchi and sugar on medium heat

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Kimchi turns translucent, edges darken slightly
sous_chef.say_en: Kimchi's translucent. Time for the rice.

steps.text_en: Add chili flakes and fry for just 10 sec

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 불 줄일 때를 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to turn down the heat
sous_chef.cue_en: Chili flakes darken as they hit the oil
sous_chef.say_en: Chili flakes burn fast. Turn it down.

steps.text_en: Add rice, press flat and fry

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue_en: Crackling gets louder
sous_chef.say_en: The bottom's about to stick.

steps.text_en: Turn off the heat, drizzle sesame oil and mix
Top with a fried egg (optional)

learn_points: 김치는 설탕 조금과 먼저 볶아야 신맛이 덜하다
고춧가루는 약불에서 짧게
learn_points_en: Fry kimchi with a little sugar first to tame the sourness
Chili flakes: low heat, short time

name: 제육볶음
prep_en: Slice the onion, cut the green onion diagonally
Mix gochujang 1 · chili flakes 1 · soy sauce 1 · sugar 1 · garlic for the sauce
Coat the pork in the sauce, rest 10 min

steps.text: 기름 두르고 중불에 양념한 고기 펼쳐 넣기
steps.text_en: Oil the pan, spread the marinated pork on medium heat

steps.text: 고기 겉이 하얗게 익을 때까지 볶기
steps.text_en: Stir-fry until the outside of the pork turns white

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Pink is gone, edges browning
sous_chef.say_en: Almost no pink left. Add the onion.

steps.text_en: Add the onion and stir-fry

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 불 줄일 때를 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to turn down the heat
sous_chef.cue: 양념이 바닥에 진하게 눌기 시작, 연기
sous_chef.cue_en: Sauce sticks dark to the pan, smoke
sous_chef.say_en: Gochujang burns fast. Down to medium-low.

steps.text_en: Add green onion for 1 min, finish with sesame oil

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Green onion just wilts
sous_chef.say_en: Done. Turn it off.

learn_points: 고추장 양념은 중불 이상에서 금방 탄다
고기 분홍색이 사라지면 채소를 넣는다
learn_points_en: Gochujang sauce burns quickly on medium heat or higher
Add vegetables once the pink is gone from the meat

name: 대패삼겹 김치볶음
prep_en: Cut the kimchi into bite-size pieces

steps.text: 기름 없이 팬에 대패삼겹 펼쳐 굽기
steps.text_en: Spread the pork belly in a dry pan and cook

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Edges brown, fat pools in the pan
sous_chef.say_en: Plenty of fat now. Add the kimchi.

steps.text: 고기 기름에 김치와 설탕 넣고 볶기
steps.text_en: Stir-fry kimchi and sugar in the pork fat
Stir-fry until the kimchi is translucent

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 불 줄일 때를 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to turn down the heat
sous_chef.cue_en: Pan bottom starts to stick dark
sous_chef.say_en: About to burn. Turn it down.

steps.text_en: Finish with sesame oil

learn_points: 대패삼겹은 기름 없이 구워 나온 기름으로 김치를 볶는다
learn_points_en: Cook thin pork belly without oil, then fry the kimchi in its fat

name: 계란후라이
prep_en: Crack the eggs into a bowl first (check for shell)

steps.text_en: Oil the pan, heat on medium
Add the egg

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 불 줄일 때를 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to turn down the heat
sous_chef.cue_en: White edges set and sizzle
sous_chef.say_en: The edges are set. Turn it down to low.

steps.text: 흰자가 다 하얘지면 불 끄기 (반숙) / 1분 더 (완숙)
steps.text_en: Turn off when the white is set (runny) / 1 more min (well done)

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Clear white over the yolk turns white
sous_chef.say: 흰자 다 익었어요. 반숙이면 지금 꺼요.
sous_chef.say_en: Whites are cooked. Turn it off now for a runny yolk.

learn_points: 흰자 가장자리가 굳으면 불을 줄인다
learn_points_en: Turn down the heat once the white edges set

name: 스크램블에그
prep_en: Beat 2 eggs with milk and salt

steps.text_en: Melt butter on low heat

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 불 줄일 때를 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to turn down the heat
sous_chef.cue_en: Butter foam starts turning brown
sous_chef.say: 버터가 타기 직전이에요. 바로 계란 부어요.
sous_chef.say_en: Butter's about to burn. Pour in the eggs now.

steps.text_en: Pour in the eggs, push in big strokes with a spatula
Turn off at 80% done

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Soft curds, surface still glossy
sous_chef.say_en: Turn it off now. The leftover heat will finish it.

learn_points: 스크램블은 덜 익었을 때 불을 끈다 (남은 열로 익음)
learn_points_en: Turn scrambled eggs off before they look done — the leftover heat finishes them

name: 간장계란밥

steps.text_en: Fry an egg with a runny yolk

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: White set, yolk still domed
sous_chef.say_en: Runny yolk. Move it onto the rice now.

steps.text_en: Put the egg and butter on the warm rice
Drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil, then mix

learn_points: 노른자를 반숙으로 두면 소스 역할을 한다
learn_points_en: A runny yolk works as the sauce

name: 두부부침

steps.text_en: Oil the pan, heat on medium
Lay the tofu in and leave it alone

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue: 아랫면 가장자리가 노릇, 팬에서 저절로 떨어짐
sous_chef.cue_en: Underside edges golden, releases from the pan
sous_chef.say: 가장자리가 노릇해요. 이제 뒤집어도 안 부서져요.
sous_chef.say_en: Edges are golden. It won't break if you flip now.

steps.text_en: Flip and brown the other side

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Both sides golden brown
sous_chef.say_en: Both sides done.

steps.text_en: Serve with soy dipping sauce (optional)

learn_points: 두부는 물기를 닦아야 기름이 덜 튄다
노릇해지기 전에 뒤집으면 부서진다
learn_points_en: Pat tofu dry so the oil spatters less
Flip before it's golden and it breaks

name: 토마토 계란볶음

steps.text: 기름 두르고 계란 부어 반만 익혀 꺼내두기
steps.text_en: Oil the pan, cook the egg halfway and set it aside

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Edges puff, center still wet
sous_chef.say_en: Half done. Move it to a bowl now.

steps.text_en: Stir-fry the tomato in the same pan

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Skins peel and juice comes out
sous_chef.say_en: Juice is out. Add the egg back.

steps.text_en: Return the egg, season with sugar and salt

steps.text: 크게 한두 번만 섞고 불 끄기
steps.text_en: Fold once or twice, then turn off

learn_points: 계란은 반만 익혀 빼뒀다가 마지막에 합친다
learn_points_en: Cook the egg halfway, set it aside, and combine at the end

name: 오므라이스

steps.text_en: Stir-fry onion and sausage, add 2 tbsp ketchup

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue_en: Ketchup starts sticking to the pan
sous_chef.say_en: The ketchup's about to stick. Add the rice.

steps.text_en: Add rice, stir-fry, and plate it
Wipe the pan, melt butter on low heat
Pour in the egg and cook just the edges

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Edges set, center still runny
sous_chef.say: 가운데가 아직 촉촉할 때 불 꺼요.
sous_chef.say_en: Turn it off while the center's still soft.

steps.text: 계란을 밥 위에 덮고 케찹 뿌리기
steps.text_en: Lay the egg over the rice, top with ketchup

learn_points: 오므라이스 계란은 가운데가 촉촉할 때 불을 끈다
케찹은 한 번 볶아야 신맛이 날아간다
learn_points_en: Turn off omurice egg while the center is still soft
Fry ketchup briefly to cook off the sour edge

name: 계란말이
prep_en: Finely chop green onion and carrot
Beat 3 eggs with salt and the vegetables

steps.text: 기름 얇게 두르고 약불에 계란물 ⅓ 붓기
steps.text_en: Thin layer of oil, pour in ⅓ of the egg on low heat

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 불 줄일 때를 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to turn down the heat
sous_chef.cue_en: Egg puffs and sizzles right away
sous_chef.say_en: Too hot. Turn it down to low.

steps.text_en: When the top is half set, roll from one end

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue_en: Top 70% set, edges lifting
sous_chef.say: 지금 말아요. 더 익으면 안 붙어요.
sous_chef.say_en: Roll now. Any later and it won't stick.

steps.text: 빈 자리에 남은 계란물 부어 이어 말기
steps.text_en: Pour the rest of the egg into the empty space and keep rolling
Once rolled, turn it to cook the outside

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue: 겉면 연한 노란색 유지, 갈색 반점 없음
sous_chef.cue_en: Outside stays pale yellow, no brown spots
sous_chef.say_en: Done. Let it cool 2 min before slicing.

learn_points: 계란말이는 약불, 윗면이 덜 굳었을 때 말아야 붙는다
learn_points_en: Low heat, and roll while the top is still soft so the layers stick

name: 시금치 계란볶음
prep: 시금치 씻어 물기 털고 반으로 자르기
prep_en: Wash the spinach, shake dry, cut in half

steps.text_en: Scramble the eggs and set aside

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Soft curds, still moist
sous_chef.say_en: Set them aside.

steps.text_en: Fry the garlic, then add the spinach

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Garlic smells fragrant, pale gold
sous_chef.say_en: Add the spinach.

steps.text: 시금치 숨이 죽으면 계란 넣고 소금 간
steps.text_en: When the spinach wilts, add the egg and season with salt

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Spinach halves in volume, deep green
sous_chef.say_en: It's wilted. Turn it off right away.

learn_points: 잎채소는 숨만 죽으면 바로 불을 끈다
learn_points_en: Turn off leafy greens as soon as they wilt

name: 스팸구이 덮밥

steps.text_en: Sear the Spam in a dry pan on medium heat

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue_en: Underside deep brown, sizzling
sous_chef.say_en: It's browned. Flip it.

steps.text_en: Sear the other side

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Both sides brown
sous_chef.say_en: Done.

steps.text_en: Lay it on rice with a fried egg and mayo

learn_points: 스팸은 자체 기름으로 굽는다
learn_points_en: Spam fries in its own fat

name: 소시지 야채볶음
prep_en: Cut onion and carrot into bite-size pieces
Mix ketchup 2 + oyster sauce ½ + sugar ⅓ + water 1

steps.text_en: Roll the sausages around the pan first

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Cuts open up, outside browns
sous_chef.say_en: The cuts opened. Add the veggies.

steps.text_en: Add the vegetables and stir-fry
Add the sauce and reduce

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue_en: Sauce turns sticky, starts clinging to the pan
sous_chef.say_en: The sauce is about to stick. Turn it off.

learn_points: 칼집이 벌어지면 소시지 속까지 데워진 것
learn_points_en: When the cuts open up, the sausage is heated through

name: 애호박전
prep_en: Slice the zucchini into 0.5 cm rounds, salt lightly
Dust with frying mix, dip in egg

steps.text_en: Oil the pan, heat on medium-low
Lay the zucchini in and cook

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue: 계란옷 가장자리가 노릇, 윗면 계란이 굳음
sous_chef.cue_en: Egg coating edges golden, top egg set
sous_chef.say_en: Edges are golden. Flip.

steps.text_en: Cook the other side

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue: 양면 연한 노란빛, 갈색 반점 약간
sous_chef.cue_en: Both sides pale yellow, a few brown spots
sous_chef.say_en: Done.

learn_points: 전은 중약불, 가장자리가 노릇해지면 뒤집는다
learn_points_en: Jeon: medium-low heat, flip when the edges turn golden

name: 감자채전
prep_en: Peel and thinly julienne the potatoes
Toss with starch and salt (don't rinse)

steps.text_en: Plenty of oil, heat on medium

steps.text: 감자채를 얇고 넓게 펴서 꾹 누르기
steps.text_en: Spread the potato thin and wide, press down
Brown the underside

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue: 가장자리 갈색, 팬을 흔들면 통째로 미끄러짐
sous_chef.cue_en: Edges brown, slides as one piece when you shake the pan
sous_chef.say_en: It moves as one piece. Time to flip.

steps.text: 기름 조금 더 두르고 반대쪽 굽기
steps.text_en: Add a little more oil, cook the other side

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Both sides crisp and brown, the sizzle quiets
sous_chef.say_en: Crispy. Turn it off.

learn_points: 감자 전분이 접착제라 헹구면 안 붙는다
팬을 흔들어 통째로 움직이면 뒤집을 때
learn_points_en: Potato starch is the glue — don't rinse it off
When it slides as one piece, it's ready to flip

name: 김치전
prep: 김치 + 부침가루 + 물 + 설탕 조금 섞기 (주르륵 흐를 정도)
prep_en: Mix kimchi + frying mix + water + a little sugar (pourable)

steps.text_en: Plenty of oil, heat on medium
Spread the batter thin

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue: 가장자리가 바삭한 갈색, 윗면 반죽이 반 이상 익음
sous_chef.cue_en: Edges crisp and brown, top more than half set
sous_chef.say_en: Edges are crisp. Flip.

steps.text_en: Flip and press down with the spatula
Crisp the other side

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Both sides brown, the sizzle gets quieter
sous_chef.say_en: Done.

learn_points: 반죽은 얇게 펼쳐야 바삭하다
뒤집고 나서 꾹 눌러야 고르게 익는다
learn_points_en: Spread the batter thin for crispiness
Press down after flipping so it cooks evenly

name: 프렌치토스트
prep_en: Mix egg, milk, sugar and salt

steps.text_en: Melt butter on low heat

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 불 줄일 때를 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to turn down the heat
sous_chef.cue_en: Butter foam starts turning brown
sous_chef.say_en: Butter's about to burn. Lay the bread in.

steps.text_en: Cook the soaked bread

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue_en: Underside deep golden
sous_chef.say_en: Nice color. Flip.

steps.text_en: Cook the other side

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Both sides golden, springy when pressed
sous_chef.say_en: Done.

learn_points: 버터는 거품이 갈색이 되기 전에 쓴다
learn_points_en: Use butter before the foam turns brown

name: 버터 감자구이
prep_en: Cut unpeeled potatoes into bite-size pieces
2 tbsp water in a bowl, cover, microwave 5 min

steps.text: 팬에 버터 녹이고 익힌 감자 넣기
steps.text_en: Melt butter, add the cooked potatoes
Roll them around to brown the outside

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Each side golden brown
sous_chef.say_en: That side's golden. Roll them.

steps.text_en: Season with salt, sugar, pepper and turn off

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: All sides golden
sous_chef.say_en: Done.

learn_points: 감자는 전자레인지로 속을 먼저 익히면 굽는 시간이 줄어든다
learn_points_en: Microwave potatoes first to cut the pan time

name: 버섯 버터구이
prep: 버섯 한입 크기로 찢거나 썰기 (물에 씻지 말고 닦기)
prep_en: Tear or slice the mushrooms (wipe, don't wash)

steps.text: 중불에서 버섯을 기름 없이 펼쳐 굽기
steps.text_en: Spread mushrooms in a dry pan on medium heat

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue_en: Underside browns, released water cooks off
sous_chef.say_en: They've browned. Flip now.

steps.text_en: Add butter and garlic, toss

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 불 줄일 때를 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to turn down the heat
sous_chef.cue_en: Butter foam turns brown
sous_chef.say_en: Butter's in. Turn it down.

steps.text: 간장 한 바퀴 두르고 불 끄기
steps.text_en: Drizzle soy sauce around and turn off

learn_points: 버섯은 처음엔 건드리지 말아야 물이 안 나오고 노릇해진다
learn_points_en: Leave mushrooms alone at first so they brown instead of going watery

name: 닭다리살 구이
prep_en: (Optional) Mix soy sauce 1 + sugar ½ + water 2

steps.text_en: Skin side down, cook on medium-low
Leave it until the skin is crisp

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue: 껍질 노릇한 갈색, 옆면 ⅔가 하얗게 익음
sous_chef.cue_en: Skin golden brown, ⅔ of the side turns white
sous_chef.say_en: ⅔ of the side is cooked. Flip.

steps.text_en: Flip, cover, cook 3 min

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue: 두꺼운 부분 투명한 육즙, 분홍색 없음
sous_chef.cue_en: Clear juices at the thickest part, no pink
sous_chef.say_en: Cooked through.

steps.text_en: (Optional) Add the sauce and reduce

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue_en: Sauce turns sticky, bubbles get bigger
sous_chef.say_en: The sauce has reduced. Turn it off.

learn_points: 닭 껍질은 처음부터 끝까지 한 번만 뒤집는다
옆면이 ⅔ 하얘지면 뒤집을 때
learn_points_en: Flip chicken thighs only once, start to finish
Flip when ⅔ of the side has turned white

name: 군만두
prep_en: Use the dumplings straight from frozen

steps.text_en: Oil the pan, brown the bottoms

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Bottoms golden brown
sous_chef.say_en: Bottoms are golden. Add water.

steps.text_en: Add 3 tbsp water and cover right away

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 끓어 넘치기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it boils over
sous_chef.cue_en: Hissing, pan fills with steam
sous_chef.say_en: Turn it down to low and leave it.

steps.text: 물이 다 날아가면 뚜껑 열어 바삭하게
steps.text_en: When the water's gone, uncover and crisp

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Water sound changes to an oil sizzle
sous_chef.say: 물 소리가 기름 소리로 바뀌었어요. 다 됐어요.
sous_chef.say_en: The water sound turned to sizzling. Done.

learn_points: 물 소리가 기름 지글 소리로 바뀌면 다 된 것
learn_points_en: When the water sound turns into an oil sizzle, it's done

name: 돈가스 부침튀김
prep_en: Thinly shred cabbage and soak in cold water (optional)
Lay paper towels next to the stove

steps.text_en: 1 cm oil in the pan, heat on medium

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 불 줄일 때를 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to turn down the heat
sous_chef.cue: 빵가루 한 알이 바로 떠오르며 거품
sous_chef.cue_en: A breadcrumb floats up right away with bubbles
sous_chef.say: 기름이 준비됐어요. 돈가스 넣고 중약불로 줄여요.
sous_chef.say_en: Oil's ready. Add the cutlet and turn it to medium-low.

steps.text_en: Add the cutlet, fry one side

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 뒤집을 때를 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when to flip
sous_chef.cue_en: Coating edges turn golden
sous_chef.say_en: It's golden. Flip.

steps.text_en: Fry the other side

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue: 양면 황금 갈색, 거품이 작아지고 소리가 높아짐
sous_chef.cue_en: Both sides golden brown, bubbles shrink, the sound gets higher
sous_chef.say_en: The bubbles got small. Take it out.

steps.text_en: Stand it on paper towels to drain

learn_points: 기름 온도는 빵가루를 떨어뜨려 확인한다
거품이 작아지고 소리가 높아지면 다 익은 것
learn_points_en: Test oil temperature with a breadcrumb
Smaller bubbles and a higher sizzle mean it's cooked

name: 계란라면

steps.text_en: Bring 550 ml water to a boil

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 끓어 넘치기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it boils over
sous_chef.cue_en: Big bubbles keep rising
sous_chef.say_en: Water's boiling. Add the noodles and soup base.

steps.text_en: Add noodles and soup base, 2 min

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 끓어 넘치기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it boils over
sous_chef.cue_en: Foam reaches the rim of the pot
sous_chef.say_en: About to boil over. Turn it down a bit.

steps.text_en: Add the egg, don't stir
Turn off at 4 min total

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Noodles loosen, broth turns cloudy
sous_chef.say_en: That's 4 minutes. For chewy noodles, now.

learn_points: 계란을 넣고 젓지 않으면 국물이 맑다
learn_points_en: Don't stir after adding the egg and the broth stays clear

name: 김치찌개
prep: 고기 또는 참치 중 하나 준비
prep_en: Cut the kimchi into bite-size pieces

steps.text_en: Oil the pot, stir-fry the pork and kimchi

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Kimchi translucent, pork white outside
sous_chef.say_en: Kimchi's translucent. Add the water.

steps.text_en: Add 300 ml water, chili flakes and sugar, bring to a boil

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 끓어 넘치기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it boils over
sous_chef.cue_en: Foam reaches the edge
sous_chef.say_en: Turn it to medium-low before it boils over.

steps.text_en: Simmer 10 min on medium-low
Add tofu and green onion, 3 more min

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Tofu takes on the broth's color
sous_chef.say_en: Done.

learn_points: 김치를 먼저 볶으면 국물이 진해진다
찌개는 끓어오르면 중약불로 오래
learn_points_en: Fry the kimchi first for a deeper broth
Stew: once it boils, simmer long on medium-low

name: 된장찌개
prep_en: Cube the potato, zucchini, onion and tofu
Mince the garlic, slice the chili

steps.text: 물 300ml에 된장 풀고 감자 넣어 끓이기
steps.text_en: Dissolve doenjang in 300 ml water, add potato, boil

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 끓어 넘치기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it boils over
sous_chef.cue_en: Foam rises to the edge
sous_chef.say_en: Before it boils over — turn it down to medium.

steps.text_en: Add zucchini, onion and garlic, 5 min
Add tofu and chili, 3 min

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Zucchini translucent, a chopstick slides into the potato
sous_chef.say_en: Done.

learn_points: 단단한 재료(감자)부터 넣는다
learn_points_en: Add the firmest ingredients (potato) first

name: 떡볶이

ingredients.label_en: A handful of rice cakes (150 g)

prep_en: Soak hardened rice cakes in water for 10 min
Cut fish cake into triangles, green onion diagonally
Mix gochujang, chili flakes, sugar and soy sauce

steps.text_en: Dissolve the sauce in 250 ml water, bring to a boil

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 끓어 넘치기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it boils over
sous_chef.cue_en: Sauce bubbling hard
sous_chef.say_en: It's boiling. Add the rice cakes.

steps.text_en: Add rice cakes and fish cake, reduce on medium

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue: 국물이 걸쭉, 떡이 바닥에 붙기 시작
sous_chef.cue_en: Sauce thickens, rice cakes start sticking to the bottom
sous_chef.say_en: It's sticking. Stir once.

steps.text_en: When the sauce is halved, add the green onion

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Thick enough to coat the rice cakes
sous_chef.say_en: That's it. Turn it off.

learn_points: 졸이는 요리는 국물이 걸쭉해지면 바닥을 자주 저어야 한다
learn_points_en: Once a braise thickens, stir the bottom often

name: 어묵볶음
prep_en: Cut the fish cake into strips
Mix soy sauce 1 + sugar ½ + water 2

steps.text_en: Oil the pan, stir-fry fish cake and onion

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Fish cake edges lightly golden
sous_chef.say_en: Lightly golden. Add the sauce.

steps.text_en: Add the sauce and reduce

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue: 양념이 거의 없어지고 바닥에 붙기 시작
sous_chef.cue_en: Sauce almost gone, starting to stick
sous_chef.say_en: The sauce is reduced. Turn it off.

steps.text_en: Finish with sesame oil

learn_points: 밑반찬 볶음은 양념이 졸아들면 바로 불을 끈다
learn_points_en: Turn off side-dish stir-fries as soon as the sauce reduces

name: 감자조림
prep: 감자 깍둑썰기 후 찬물에 5분 담가 전분 빼기
prep_en: Cube the potatoes, soak in cold water 5 min to remove starch
Mix soy sauce 2 + sugar 1 + water 150 ml

steps.text_en: Sear the potatoes in oil

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Potato surface turns translucent
sous_chef.say_en: The outside is translucent. Pour in the sauce.

steps.text_en: Pour in the sauce, cover, 10 min on medium-low

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 끓어 넘치기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it boils over
sous_chef.cue_en: Foam pushes out from under the lid
sous_chef.say_en: It's about to overflow. Crack the lid.

steps.text_en: Uncover and reduce the sauce

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue_en: Sauce almost gone, crackling from the bottom
sous_chef.say_en: About to burn. Turn it off.

learn_points: 조림은 마지막에 뚜껑을 열어 국물을 날린다
learn_points_en: Uncover at the end of a braise to cook off the sauce

name: 알리오올리오
prep: 1구라면 면 먼저 삶아 면물 한 컵 남기고 건지기
prep_en: With 1 burner: cook the pasta first, save a cup of pasta water, drain

steps.text: 물 1L에 소금 넣고 면 삶기 (봉지 시간 -1분)
steps.text_en: Salt 1 L water, cook pasta (package time −1 min)

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 끓어 넘치기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it boils over
sous_chef.cue_en: Foam rises over the pot
sous_chef.say_en: Boiling over. Turn it down a little.

steps.text: 면물 한 컵 떠두고 면 건지기
steps.text_en: Save a cup of pasta water, drain

steps.text: 팬에 올리브유와 마늘 넣고 약불로 켜기
steps.text_en: Olive oil and garlic in the pan, then turn on low

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Garlic pale gold, bubbles get smaller
sous_chef.say: 연한 금색이에요. 고추 넣고 바로 면물 부어요.
sous_chef.say_en: Pale gold. Add the chili, then the pasta water right away.

steps.text: 면물 ½컵과 면 넣고 흔들며 섞기
steps.text_en: Add ½ cup pasta water and the pasta, shake to mix

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Sauce turns milky and clings to the pasta
sous_chef.say_en: The sauce is clinging. Done.

learn_points: 면물의 전분이 기름과 섞여야 소스가 된다
마늘은 연한 금색에서 멈춘다
learn_points_en: Starch in the pasta water turns the oil into a sauce
Stop the garlic at pale gold

name: 우유 크림파스타
prep: 면은 봉지 시간보다 2분 덜 삶아 건지기
prep_en: Slice the onion, chop the bacon
Cook pasta 2 min less than the package says, drain

steps.text_en: Stir-fry bacon and onion in butter

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue_en: Bacon edges crisp, onion translucent
sous_chef.say_en: Good. Pour in the milk.

steps.text_en: Pour in the milk and warm it

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 끓어 넘치기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it boils over
sous_chef.cue_en: Small bubbles ring the edge
sous_chef.say_en: Milk boils over fast. Turn it to low.

steps.text_en: Add pasta and cheese, reduce

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue: 소스가 숟가락 뒷면에 묻을 만큼 걸쭉
sous_chef.cue_en: Sauce coats the back of a spoon
sous_chef.say_en: That's thick enough. Turn it off.

steps.text_en: Season with salt and pepper

learn_points: 우유는 가장자리 거품이 보이면 약불 (확 넘친다)
소스는 식으면서 더 걸쭉해진다
learn_points_en: Milk: turn to low when bubbles ring the edge — it boils over suddenly
The sauce thickens more as it cools

name: 볶음우동
prep_en: Loosen the udon in hot water for 30 sec, drain
Mix soy sauce 1 + oyster sauce 1 + sugar ½

steps.text_en: Stir-fry the meat and vegetables on high heat

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 색을 봐줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will watch the color
sous_chef.cue: 양배추 숨이 반쯤 죽고 가장자리 갈색
sous_chef.cue_en: Cabbage half wilted, edges brown
sous_chef.say_en: Veggies are half done. Add the noodles.

steps.text_en: Add noodles and sauce, toss quickly

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue: 면이 팬에 붙고 소스가 눌기 시작
sous_chef.cue_en: Noodles cling to the pan, sauce starts sticking
sous_chef.say_en: It's sticking. Keep lifting and tossing.

steps.text: 소스가 면에 다 배면 불 끄기
steps.text_en: Turn off once the noodles soak up the sauce

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: No liquid left on the pan
sous_chef.say_en: Done.

learn_points: 볶음면은 면을 미리 풀어둬야 팬에서 안 끊긴다
learn_points_en: Loosen the noodles first so they don't break in the pan

name: 참치마요덮밥
prep_en: Mix ½ tbsp soy sauce + a pinch of sugar

steps.text_en: Scramble the egg and set aside

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 다 됐을 때 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will tell you when it's done
sous_chef.cue_en: Soft curds, still moist
sous_chef.say_en: Set them aside.

steps.text: 같은 팬에 참치·간장 소스 넣고 30초 볶기
steps.text_en: In the same pan, stir-fry tuna with the soy sauce for 30 sec

sous_chef.label: 믿쥐가 눌어붙기 전에 알려줄게요
sous_chef.label_en: Mitzy will warn you before it sticks
sous_chef.cue_en: Soy sauce starts sticking
sous_chef.say_en: About to stick. Turn it off.

steps.text_en: Top the rice with egg, tuna and mayo

learn_points: 간장은 바닥에 닿으면 금방 눌어서 짧게 볶는다
learn_points_en: Soy sauce sticks fast once it hits the pan, so keep it short
